= Memcached
:page-aliases: operation::configuration/cache/memcached.adoc
:description: Cache tiles using memcached.
:page-eyebrow: Cache
:page-config-name: memcached
:page-related: cache/index.adoc[Cache Overview], datastores/memcached.adoc[Memcached Datastore], cache/redis.adoc[Redis Cache]

NOTE: Requires a xref:datastores/memcached.adoc[memcached datastore] to supply the connection.

== Example
[tabs]
====
YAML::
+
[,yaml]
----
datastores:
  - name: memcached
    id: memcached-0
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 11211

cache:
  name: memcached
  datastore: memcached-0
----

JSON::
+
[,json]
----
{
  "datastores": [
    {
      "name": "memcached",
      "id": "memcached-0",
      "host": "127.0.0.1",
      "port": 11211
    }
  ],
  "cache": {
    "name": "memcached",
    "datastore": "memcached-0"
  }
}
----
====

== Configuration

.Configuration options
[cols="1m,3,1,1,1"]
|===
| Parameter | Description | Type | Required | Default

| keyprefix
| A prefix to use for keys stored in cache. Helps avoid collisions when multiple applications use the same memcached
| string
| No
| None

| ttl
| How long cache entries should persist for in seconds. Cannot be disabled.
| uint32
| No
| 1 day

| datastore
| The ID of a xref:datastores/memcached.adoc[memcached datastore] to use.
| string
| Yes
| None
|===
